Cost: 2,000eb (Very Expensive)
Class: Exotic Sniper Rifle
Range: Anti-Material Rifle
Pre-installed: Bipod, Precision Stock, Sniper Rifle Rechamber, Sniping Scope (effects already included in these stats)

All attacks take -2 to hit. After each shot, working the bolt takes an Action. Armor ablation increases by 2 SP (3 total). Drawing it always takes an Action. While Prone or bipod-mounted, rolling a 2 on the attack check gives +1, and rolling a 1 gives +2 (Precision Stock). Can't take a Folding Structure. Needs BODY 6+ to wield unless mounted.

Foundry notes:

  • Damage is 7d6, dropping the lowest die. CPR 0.92.4 can't drop dice automatically, so drop them by hand from the damage roll.
  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).
  • Exotic weapon.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
